name: Puerto Boyacá (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of grey, white and green, the white charged with the municipal arms of Puerto Boyacá with lion supporters.
history: Municipal flag of Puerto Boyacá, a municipality in the department of Boyacá, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: Puerto Boyacá arms — with lion supporters and a scroll
